findings.title: Acceptance mapping is neither specification-faithful nor uniquely owned
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 5: “All 20 specification acceptance criteria are assigned to exactly one primary prompt owner.”
findings.trigger: The acceptance mapping is used to verify primary ownership of criteria 1–20.
findings.consequence: The required one-to-one traceability cannot be established, so downstream prompts cannot reliably determine which specification acceptance tests they must satisfy.
findings.evidence: `acceptance_criteria_mapping.v1.md` substitutes invented criteria such as “System baseline behavioral capture” for specification §10 Criterion 1, which is “Installed imports.” It similarly remaps the rest of the numbered tests. Its Criterion 4 row assigns the owner as `P00A + P01–P10`, directly violating exactly-one-primary-owner, while its summary inconsistently lists Criterion 4 under P00A alone.

findings.title: New P02S prompt is outside P00A's authorized creation paths
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 permits new artifacts only under `prompts/resolved/`, `prompts/generated/`, `checkpoints/P00A/`, and `execution/P00A/`; the repair authority does not extend to downstream prompt modifications.
findings.trigger: The P00A checkpoint delta is checked against its authorized paths.
findings.consequence: The checkpoint contains an unauthorized downstream prompt artifact and therefore cannot satisfy the authorized-path gate.
findings.evidence: Git status shows untracked `plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/P02S_structured_data_codemod.prompt.v4.yaml`. The P00A prompt authorizes generated prompts only under `plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/generated/`, and Criterion 7's allowed untracked-path list likewise excludes the root `prompts/` directory.

observations: The prior P00A-B02 defect is resolved: P02S v4 now explicitly owns and applies live structured-file transformations with parser, fixture, dry-run, and idempotence controls, and the manifest references v4 exclusively.
The original P02S v3 file is restored byte-for-byte to its HEAD digest, resolving the in-place-overwrite aspect of prior P00A-B04.
The checkpoint claims P02S v4 has nine tests, but the prompt contains eight test entries. This does not independently defeat one of the seven stated checkpoint criteria.
reasoning: The round history matches my prior verdict. I verified both P00A and P02S v4 against the prompt schema successfully, confirmed the original v3 digest matches HEAD, and found the structured-edit ownership contradiction repaired. Two blocker-level defects remain: the acceptance map does not map the actual numbered specification criteria and contains a multi-owner assignment, and the new v4 prompt was created outside P00A's expressly authorized paths.
